**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Sparkling:

- **§ 2 (Grant of License, p0028):** the licence is expressly "non-transferable and non-exclusive" — a grant characteristic, not a purchasing restriction.
- **§ 3 (Restrictions on Use):** limited to copying, assignment/sublicence, reverse engineering and protection of the Software; no restriction on procuring from third parties.
- **§ 10–11 (Maintenance and Fees):** Sparkling must pay maintenance fees per the Fee Schedule, but nothing requires it to source maintenance, support or any other goods/services solely from Garman.
- **§ 20 (General Matters):** no minimum-purchase, requirements or non-compete covenant.

Other "exclusive" hits are benign: the non-exclusive escrow licence (p0115), the mutual exclusive-remedy clause (p0105), and non-exclusive jurisdiction (p0146).

This sits at the **preferred** position (no exclusivity on Customer), so no edit is warranted.
